A small farming '''town''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Terra Sool]]. A [[Conqueror-class atmospheric dreadnaught|''Conqueror''-class atmospheric dreadnaught]] fought the Terra Sool militia above the town during a [[Battle of Terra Sool|battle]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
